description: In every PA-model, the history at zero is the empty list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history_zero_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value
      (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
